summary_1line: Dhritarashtra asks about events after Arjuna’s vow to kill Bhishma; Bhishma accepts command of the Kaurava army and begins classifying major warriors.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma, white-haired and radiant in armor, addresses Duryodhana in the war camp while assembled kings listen around him.
Duryodhana stands confidently before Bhishma and Drona, declaring he fears neither gods nor asuras with them leading his army.
The aged warrior Bhishma raises his hand while listing the mighty rathas and atirathas as rows of armored kings and chariots fill the background.
